text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a day out, Hishi Akebono and I are
on our
way home when...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I wonder what Nature's up to over
there?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good timing, Akebono! And your
trainer's
here with you, too? Hey there.
Could you both
lend me your ears for a
sec?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature hands us a flyer with
pictures of
teacups, plates, and
earthenware pots on it, as
well as the
slogan, "Create art unique to you."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
This is for... a free trial of a ceramics
class?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So, basically, I'm friends with one of the

shopkeepers in the shopping district,
and he
asked me to stop by and observe
one of his
classes...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Except my schedule's packed right now,
and I
can't go. Sooo...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Do you think you two could attend in my
place? If
you go now, you'll get to make
a ceramic piece
for free!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
We'll go, we'll go! You don't have to us
ask twice!
Right, Trainer? ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since Hishi Akebono has already
answered for the
both of us, I agree to
attend the event. On the
day of the free
ceramics class...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm so excited to make a one-of-a-kind
art piece.
Hehe! I'll have to take a
picture of it and send it
to my parents
when it's done!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
A pot for making chanko, of course! I
want to
make it so big it'll take at least
two people to
hold!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: What?! I can't make a pot?!

text_block_list.name: Ceramics Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's not that you can't, but a pot
would be a
little too advanced for a
beginner to make.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hmm... That makes sense. I bet it would be tough to make something you're supposed to stick right over a fire...

text_block_list.name: Ceramics Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. Why don't you try making
something
easier fir—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll have to do my very best, then!
A clay
pot it is!

text_block_list.name: Ceramics Instructor
text_block_list.text: What?! You still want to make a pot?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please! Oh, but I want to make a
really big
one, so I don't mind if you
charge me for the
materials and
instruction.

text_block_list.name: Ceramics Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's of no matter to me, but...
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Ceramics Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Experience... Indeed. And besides, it's
delightful
simply having someone so
enthusiastic about
ceramics attending
the class...
choice_data_list: Everything's a learning experience, after all.
Why not hone your skills before taking on the challenge?

text_block_list.name: Ceramics Instructor
text_block_list.text: Very well! Let's do what we can!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! Thank you so much! And thank
you, too,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ceramics Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Let's start with the design first. Go
ahead and
sketch the sort of pot you
wish to make.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Okay! Ehehe! Here I go! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I want to make it reaaally big and smooth... This part should be like this, so it can hold a lot of ingredients, and then this part should be...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The design Hishi Akebono comes up
with is
beyond intricate and would
probably be difficult
for even a
professional to realize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a serious expression on her face,
she revises
her draft multiple times and
continues adjusting
her design. Then,
finally...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Phew! There, I'm done! Here's the design
for my
special, one-of-a-kind pot! What
do you think,
sir?

text_block_list.name: Ceramics Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure about this? Don't get me

wrong—this is a wonderful design—but it
looks
incredibly challenging to make...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best, sir!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps swept up by Hishi Akebono's
contagious
enthusiasm, our instructor
almost reflexively nods
in approval.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ultimately, although Hishi Akebono only
gets as
far as finalizing her pot design
today, she still
enjoys the entire process.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh... But I still want to make a pot
for my first
ceramics piece! Nothing else
will do.

text_block_list.name: Ceramics Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Why do you want to make a pot so
badly?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I just really love cooking! That's why I'm
so
nitpicky about tableware.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I know a cooking pot isn't really
"tableware" like
plates and stuff are, but
a pot's still an important
tool for good
food presentation!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And that's the reason I want to make my
very own
pot!

text_block_list.name: Ceramics Instructor
text_block_list.text:
I see... That makes sense. Very well. Let's
try to
make something good, then. Now,
to do that, we
must start with the
design!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir! I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono begins studiously
working on her
design for a perfect
earthenware pot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ultimately, although she only gets as far
as
finalizing her pot design, she still
manages to
make something she's both
satisfied with and
proud of.
